title: Third conditional and mixed
rule: Il terzo periodo ipotetico inglese (unreal past): una condizione passata che non si è realizzata e una conseguenza passata che quindi non c'è stata. Forma: if + past perfect (had + participio) + would have / could have / might have + participio. Se avessi saputo, ti avrei chiamato = If I had known, I would have called. Contrazione 'd have = would have. Could have per capacità (avrei potuto); might have per possibilità (potrebbe aver). Mai would nella clausola con if. Il condizionale misto esiste in due forme: (1) condizione passata + conseguenza presente: if + past perfect + would + base (Se avessi studiato francese, vivrei a Montréal adesso = If I had studied French, I'd live in Montréal now). (2) Condizione presente + conseguenza passata: if + past simple + would have + part. (Se fossi meglio organizzata, avrei finito ieri = If I were better organised, I would have finished yesterday). Wish + past perfect per il rammarico passato: I wish I had taken the job (vorrei aver preso il lavoro). Should have / could have / would have / might have + part. per i rimpianti e le possibilità. In scrittura: would have, could have, should have; nel parlato: would've, could've, should've — mai would of, should of (errore anche dei madrelingua).

blocks.caption: Il terzo periodo ipotetico e il misto
head: Schema
Esempio
rows: 3° (passato → passato): if + past perfect, + would have + part.
If I had known, I would have called.
negative
If she hadn't missed the deadline, she wouldn't have had to reapply.
could / might have per capacità / possibilità
If I'd studied, I could have passed. They might have won.
misto (passato → presente): if + past perfect, + would + base
If I had learned French, I'd live in Montréal now.
misto (presente → passato): if + past simple, + would have + part.
If I were more organised, I would have finished yesterday.

blocks.caption: Wish and should have
head: Schema
Esempio
rows: wish + past perfect (rammarico passato)
I wish I had taken the job.
if only + past perfect (desiderio più forte)
If only I'd learned French.
should have + part. (avrei dovuto)
I should have called.
could have + part. (avrei potuto)
I could have been there.
would have + part. (sarei)
I would have come if I'd known.
might have + part. (potrebbe aver)
She might have missed the train.

items.t: If I had known about Express Entry, I would have applied last year.
items.n: Se avessi saputo di Express Entry, avrei fatto domanda l'anno scorso.

items.t: If I had learned French at twenty, I'd live in Montréal now.
items.n: Se avessi imparato il francese a vent'anni, vivrei a Montréal adesso.

items.t: I wish I had taken the IELTS last December. I should have asked Priya earlier.
items.n: Vorrei aver fatto lo IELTS a dicembre. Avrei dovuto chiedere a Priya prima.

blocks.title: Il periodo ipotetico tipo 3 italiano
blocks.text: Third conditional inglese = periodo ipotetico italiano della irrealtà passata: se + congiuntivo trapassato + condizionale passato. [[If I had known, I would have called]] = [[se avessi saputo, avrei chiamato]]. Mappa uno a uno. Il misto esiste anche in italiano: Se avessi studiato francese, vivrei a Montréal adesso = cong. trapassato + condizionale presente.

items.wrong: If I would have known, I would have called.
items.right: If I had known, I would have called.
items.why: Mai would nella clausola con if.

items.wrong: If I knew, I would have called.
items.right: If I had known, I would have called.
items.why: Match tenses: past perfect in if, would have + part. in main.

items.wrong: I wish I would have taken the job.
items.right: I wish I had taken the job.
items.why: Wish + past perfect, mai wish + would have.

items.wrong: I should have to call her.

items.why: Nel parlato suona would've; nella scrittura, mai would of.

items.q: If I ___ (know, past perfect) earlier, I ___ (apply). If she ___ (study, past perfect) harder, she ___ (pass).
items.n: Se avessi saputo prima, avrei fatto domanda. Se avesse studiato di più, avrebbe passato.

items.q: If I ___ (learn, past perfect) French, I ___ (live, cond.) in Montréal now. I ___ (should + call, past) her.
items.n: Se avessi imparato il francese, vivrei a Montréal adesso. Avrei dovuto chiamarla.

answers: If I had known I would have called
